messages.content: What is the time now in New York City?

function.name: calculate_sunrise_and_sunset
function.description: Calculate the sunrise and sunset time of a location for the given date. Note that the provided function is in Python 3 syntax.

location.description: The location in city, state format.

date.description: The date for which the sunrise and sunset needs to be calculated in yyyy-mm-dd format.

message.content:
I don’t have real‑time clock data, but I can tell you how to figure it out:

| Time zone | UTC offset | When it applies |
|-----------|------------|-----------------|
| Eastern Standard Time (EST) | UTC‑5 | November – March |
| Eastern Daylight Time (EDT) | UTC‑4 | April – October |

Today is **May 29, 2026**, so New York City is on **Eastern Daylight Time (UTC‑4)**.  
If you know the current UTC time, simply subtract four hours to get the local time in New York City. If you’re looking for an exact current time, you’ll need to check a reliable world‑clock source or your device’s clock set to the “America/New York” time zone.
